notes.title: The «Lost Media» update is now online!
notes.notes: [p][b]A new storyline[/b] has been added that uncovers the lost game where Nefasto was one of the main characters before becoming the hero of the Kick The Can shovelware. This story can be unlocked by following a few secret routes.[/p][p][b]6 new quests[/b] alongside some new sidestories with NPCs.[/p][p][b]2 new endings[/b] with their associated achievement.[/p][p][b]A new character[/b] linked to the new «time travel» feature. Once you unlocked one of the main endings, this will unlock the possibility to travel to a story node, so you can try unlocking new routes without redoing the game from the start.[/p][p][b]Glitch can now sell you cheats[/b] and do other things in exchange for time and Golden Ram Tickets (and more), unlocked after your first Game over, or a main ending.[/p][p]A new revamped options UI and some added quality of life features like the [b]possibility to skip[/b] some cutscenes that you’ve already seen.[/p][p]And many [i]many[/i] new secrets, and hidden scenes to find.[/p][p][/p][p]As a last thing, a very needed free [b][i]DEMO version[/i][/b] is also made available.[/p][p][/p][p]See you back in the weird world that is your computer![/p]

notes.title: July the 10th, 2025, will be the release date for the "Lost Media" Update
notes.notes: [p]We are happy to announce that the [b]Patch v1.50, "Lost Media" update[/b], for [i]Nefasto's Misadventure : Meeting Noeroze[/i] is scheduled to be released on [b]July the 10th![/b][/p][p]This update will include brand new content and quality of life additions that were previously announced, with Glitch being more of a troll than ever before.[/p][p]Also you can unlock [b][i]a brand new adventure[/i][/b] that involves Nefasto's lost and unfinished game.[/p][p]Until the release of the patch [i]Nefasto's Misadventure : Meeting Noeroze[/i] will be on sale with [b]50% off[/b] starting today![/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.10
Patch 1.04
notes.notes:
Thank you for everyone who has been playing [i]Nefasto's Misadventure - Meeting Noeroze[/i]!
We are happy to see the good reception the game has so far, without excluding the occasional ragers.

This first patch brings small fixes. Most of them involve weird graphical behaviour with ultra wide screens. Some small continuity errors and typos that escaped us have been ironed out.

We were made aware of an unfortunate issue with the hints, using the [i]Golden RAM Tickets[/i], during the Pixel Code quest. There's a specific order of sequence during that quest that can result to a wrong hint returned, leading any stuck player to an incorrect path for solving some of the puzzles. This patch should fix this.
Apologies for making that quest as difficult as the Hard Mode route because of that bug. Kudos to the players who managed it through regardless. As for those who wasted their Golden Ticket, we hope you used [b]Save Scumming[/b] to get it back.

As a closing message, the game has [url=https://discord.gg/dBRCzFgYQF]an official Discord Server[/url] and we invite you there if you are stuck on an particular part of the game, notice an issue and to simply hang out.

notes.title: New Update 0.42
notes.notes: A new update of [i]Nefasto's Misadventure: Meeting Noeroze[/i] is ready for you! New quests, cutscenes and routes are added, bosses are more balanced, and with all that many fixes and polish. You are now ready to help our hero escape this dreadful computer!

notes.title: New Update 0.13c
notes.notes:
[b]This update contains various bug fixes[/b], big and small, that we found in the previous version. And also:
[list]
[*]- [b]An overhaul of the "Deltree" boss logic[/b] where attack patterns have been refined and new small events added to make this first fight less punitive.
[*]- [b]New events and secret cutscenes[/b] have been added into the main story.
[/list]
